title: Tunisian Pan-Seared Asparagus Fritters
description: A flavorful and crispy fritter recipe loaded with sautéed Tunisian asparagus, perfect for any meal.
instructions: In a large skillet, heat olive oil over medium-high heat.
Sauté asparagus for 3-4 minutes until slightly tender.
In a separate bowl, whisk together eggs, parmesan cheese, and tunisian spice blend.
In another bowl, combine flour and a pinch of salt.
Add the flour mixture to the egg mixture and stir until just combined.
Add the cooked asparagus to the egg mixture and stir until well combined.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the asparagus mixture into the skillet.
Using a spatula, flatten the mixture into a patty shape.
Cook the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce.
